caption: The image contains a symmetrical design centered on a textured beige background. At the top, there is a stylized cross in muted orange and outlined in red, with blue and light yellow decorative patterns inside it. Below the cross, there is a ribbon-like bow shape rendered in blue with inner sections of orange and yellow dots, connected at the center by a small blue and orange circle. Extending sideways from the bow are two wing-like shapes colored yellow with maroon tips. Underneath these elements, there is a large circular medallion featuring concentric patterns in blue, red, and yellow. The circle’s outer ring is blue and red, followed by a sequence of repeating yellow shapes, and the inner sections show red and blue petal-like forms surrounding a yellow central disc with a blue dot. The entire composition is neatly arranged in the center of the page.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
